title: Pilot photo of ARV over Provo

tellings.quote: He has an image taken by a pilot Harvey something I can't quite remember over Provo Utah right by Dougway proving grounds in the 60s

plain: In the 1960s, a pilot named Harvey is said to have photographed a craft over Provo, Utah, close to Dugway Proving Ground, a military testing range, and the craft is taken to be an ARV, short for alien reproduction vehicle, meaning a human-built copy of a non-human craft. The guest UAPGerb, an online researcher who argues that Utah is the new Area 51 (the secret Nevada air base), says the image belongs to a man named Mark McCandlish, and admits he cannot quite remember the pilot's full name. If true, it would put such man-made copies in the air over Utah decades ago.
